GM G+ 35W Universal Charger – Compact Fast Charging for Travel & Everyday Use

The GM G+ 35W Universal Charger TravelEase Pro with Retractable Cable, 75cm Type C Cable, Universal Plug Charger with 2 USB-C & 2 USB-A Ports, Gan Fast Charging Travel Charger, Indicator, Advanced Safety Features is designed for modern travelers and professionals who need powerful, reliable, and space-saving charging on the go. Built with next-generation GaN fast charging technology, this charger delivers efficient power in a compact form, making it ideal for home, office, and international travel.

With a smart combination of 2 USB-C ports and 2 USB-A ports, the GM G+ TravelEase Pro allows you to charge multiple devices simultaneously without compromising speed. Whether you are powering smartphones, tablets, earbuds, power banks, or other USB-enabled devices, this 35W universal travel charger ensures consistent and stable output.

Fast & Efficient GaN Charging Technology

Powered by advanced Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology, this charger generates less heat and delivers faster charging compared to traditional chargers. The optimized power distribution supports fast charging for Type-C devices, reducing charging time while maintaining high energy efficiency. The built-in 75cm retractable Type-C cable adds unmatched convenience, eliminating cable clutter and making it easier to pack in bags or luggage. This feature makes the charger especially useful for frequent travelers and professionals who value organization.

Universal Compatibility for Global Travel

Designed as a universal plug charger, the GM G+ TravelEase Pro supports a wide voltage range, making it suitable for use in different countries and regions. It works seamlessly with Android smartphones, USB-C laptops (up to supported wattage), Bluetooth devices, smartwatches, and more.

  • Compatible with smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and accessories
  • Supports USB-C Power Delivery fast charging
  • Ideal as a travel charger, office charger, or home charging hub
  • Compact and lightweight design for easy portability

Multi-Port Charging Without Speed Loss

The intelligent power management system distributes output efficiently across all ports. This allows you to charge up to four devices at once while maintaining safe and stable performance. The LED indicator provides clear charging status, so you always know when power is active.

Advanced Safety Features You Can Trust

Safety is a core focus of the GM G+ TravelEase Pro. The charger includes advanced protection mechanisms to safeguard your devices during every charge.

  • Over-voltage protection
  • Over-current protection
  • Short-circuit protection
  • Over-temperature control
  • Fire-resistant and durable housing

These built-in safety features ensure long-term durability and protect both the charger and connected devices from electrical risks.

Why Choose GM G+ TravelEase Pro?

If you are looking for a fast charging GaN travel charger that combines power, safety, and convenience, the GM G+ TravelEase Pro stands out. Its sleek design, retractable cable, and multi-device support make it an excellent choice for business travelers, digital nomads, and everyday users. Upgrade your charging experience with a compact 35W universal charger that delivers speed, reliability, and peace of mind wherever you go.
